profile.headline: Experienced Public Health Technology Leader

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Skylight is a digital consultancy using design and technology to help government agencies deliver better public services.

https://skylight.digital/


CDC - National Electronic Disease Surveillance System (NEDSS) Base System (NBS)
Modernizing the Report Module for NBS 7, the next-gen public health disease surveillance platform used by state and local health departments. I participated in the development team that:
- Re-engineered legacy backend architecture from a Java/SAS environment to a modern Spring Boot framework executing native Python programs.
- Refactored and migrated complex legacy SAS reporting scripts into maintainable, high-performance Python modules, eliminating proprietary software dependencies and licensing overhead.
- Rebuilt legacy UI components using React to improve user experience and interface performance

positions.title: Integration Engineer
positions.description: Engaged with the Pandemic Ready Interoperability Modernization Effort (PRIME) through the CDC to connect State, Territorial, Local, and Tribal public health jurisdictions with the ReportStream system. Focused on modern and scalable technologies our focus is to ease the ELR burden both testing facilities and public health departments.

company.name: Louisiana Office of Public Health Bureau of Infectious Diseases

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
My responsibilities have two areas of focus. First, I manage all Electronic Laboratory Report importing and central management.  These applications, all using SQL Server, are a combination of VB.NET and C#.NET console applications. Electronic laboratory results ,in HL7 format and transferred via sFTP, are sent from Hospitals, Medical Clinics, Laboratories, and various other medical testing facilities. These applications read and insert the contents to the appropriate database. I have maintained this system of applications for the past three years. Over the past year, I have developed a single replacement system. All ELR are now managed via the Rhapsody Integration Engine with a SQL Server archive.

Second, I built and maintain a C#.NET Web Application to assist with HIV\AIDS Surveillance. Using Entity Framework to manage the data layer, this application retrieves tests concerning HIV\AIDS, combines the results with current patient data, and presents the cases to the appropriate cases worker.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description: I develop systems for the division's websites and needed web applications using PHP, MySQL, HTML, and CSS. Many applications were built using the PHP MVC framework, CodeIgniter.
